gui.retrograde.chunk_map.title: Chunk Status
gui.retrograde.chunk_map.singleplayer_on: Chunk map is singleplayer-only for now
gui.retrograde.chunk_map.controls_hint: Drag or WASD: pan  ·  Click: select chunk  ·  Shift-drag: select area  ·  Ctrl-drag: deselect  ·  Scroll: zoom
gui.retrograde.chunk_map.controls_hint_s: Drag: pan  ·  Shift-drag: select  ·  Scroll: zoom
gui.retrograde.chunk_map.panel.ores.tip: Show or hide the full ore breakdown for this chunk, names and all.
gui.retrograde.chunk_map.action.regen.ti: Roll the selected chunks back to freshly generated terrain.
gui.retrograde.chunk_map.action.undo.tip: Restore the selected chunks from the snapshot taken before their last regen.
gui.retrograde.chunk_map.action.retrogen: Run another mod's own retrogen over the selected chunks, leaving your builds alone.
gui.retrograde.chunk_map.action.clear.ti: Deselect every chunk. The selection is kept so Restore can bring it back.
gui.retrograde.chunk_map.action.find.tip: Search the mapped chunks by whether you've been there, whether they're slime chunks, which biome they're in, and what ore they hold — then select everything that matches.
gui.retrograde.chunk_map.filter.title: FIND CHUNKS
gui.retrograde.chunk_map.filter.scope.ti: Which chunks to search. Only chunks the map has already read can be searched — pan over an area to make it searchable.
Limit to chunks you've been in, or to ones you never have.
gui.retrograde.chunk_map.filter.slime.ti: Limit to slime chunks, or to ones that aren't. Overworld only — the pattern means nothing anywhere else.
gui.retrograde.chunk_map.filter.biome.ti: Cycle through the biomes actually present in the chunks being searched.
gui.retrograde.chunk_map.filter.ore.tip: Cycle through the ores actually found in the chunks being searched.
gui.retrograde.chunk_map.filter.ore_rule: Whether the picked ore has to be there or has to be missing.
gui.retrograde.chunk_map.filter.select.t: Add every highlighted chunk to the selection, nearest to you first if there are more than the cap allows.
Put back the selection as it was before the last thing that replaced it.
gui.retrograde.chunk_map.filter.close.ti: Close this panel. The selection stays as it is.
gui.retrograde.preview.title: Regenerate %s chunk(s)?
gui.retrograde.preview.warning: Builds and mining in these chunks are destroyed.
gui.retrograde.preview.confirm.tip: Each chunk goes back to freshly generated terrain. A snapshot is taken first, but only the last few regens per chunk are kept — older ones can't be undone. You'll be moved clear of the area while it runs and put back afterwards.
gui.retrograde.confirm_undo.detail: This puts back the terrain as it was just before the last regen. Anything generated since is lost. Chunks with no snapshot are skipped. You'll be moved clear of the area while it happens and put back afterwards.
gui.retrograde.job.already_running: Another chunk job is still running
gui.retrograde.job.phase.moving: Moving you clear of the work area…
gui.retrograde.job.phase.cancelled: Cancelled — chunks already done were kept
gui.retrograde.retrogen.title: Retrogen — %s chunk(s)
gui.retrograde.retrogen.none_available: No loaded mods have a known retrogen integration
gui.retrograde.retrogen.confirm.detail: This runs that mod's own retrogen command, one chunk at a time. Retrograde doesn't control what it does from there — check that mod's own settings if it refuses.
gui.retrograde.retrogen.dispatch_failed: Retrograde: couldn't run %s's retrogen command — check the log
gui.retrograde.chunk_map.action.manipula: Everything that changes the selected chunks: regenerate, undo, another mod's retrogen, and whatever else is switched on in settings.
gui.retrograde.manipulate.title: Chunk Manipulation — %s chunk(s)
gui.retrograde.manipulate.set_biome.tip: Rewrite which biome the selected chunks are in. The blocks stay exactly where they are — only the fog, grass colour, weather and mob spawns change.
gui.retrograde.biome_edit.title: Set biome — %s chunk(s)
gui.retrograde.biome_edit.pick.tip: Cycles through every biome this world registered, not just the ones you've visited.
gui.retrograde.biome_edit.apply.tip: Runs vanilla's fillbiome over each selected chunk. There is no undo for this — regen would rebuild the terrain too.
gui.retrograde.biome_edit.none: This world has no biomes registered to pick from.
gui.retrograde.settings.title: Retrograde Settings
gui.retrograde.settings.slime.tip: Mark chunks where slimes can spawn underground, and let the filter search for them.
gui.retrograde.settings.confirm.tip: Ask a second time before anything that overwrites chunks you've built in. Leave this on.
Cover the whole screen while a job runs. Regen moves you above the build height and back, and watching that through a see-through screen looks like the game breaking.
gui.retrograde.settings.unload_timeout.t: How long a job waits for a chunk to unload before giving up on it and reporting it skipped. Forced and spawn chunks never unload, so this is what stops the job waiting forever.
gui.retrograde.settings.watchdog_timeout: How long a job may make no progress at all before it aborts itself and puts you back where you started.
gui.retrograde.settings.cheats.tip: Master switch for operations that hand you things you didn't earn. Off by default, and while it's off those operations aren't shown at all.
gui.retrograde.settings.biome_edit.tip: Let Chunk Manipulation rewrite a chunk's biome in place.
gui.retrograde.settings.ore_edit.tip: Let Chunk Manipulation change how much ore a chunk holds. Not built yet — the toggle is here, the operation isn't.
gui.retrograde.job.phase.force_cancelled: Stopped — the chunk in progress may be incomplete
gui.retrograde.job.phase.watchdog: No progress for %ss — aborted and put you back
gui.retrograde.job.phase.done_stubborn: Done — %s chunk(s) stayed loaded and were skipped
gui.retrograde.job.warn.stranded: You may still be above the world with gravity off.
